# dsh-tui-marathon
简体中文
A Marathon-inspired appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness TUI. Version 0.4.3 provides an Acid Rain
theme and a responsive full-screen opening through the stock TUI's public interfaces. Conversations,
models, tools and storage remain with Harness / dsh-TUI.
**Inspired by the repo ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop**
Version 0.4.3: actual 120×36 terminal output, replayed as a 24 fps GIF (about 10.3 seconds). The log
o stays visible through the blue hold and maze transition until the red sweep covers it. The native
interface returns after the opening.
The repository is named `dsh-tui-marathon`; the installable Cordis package is `dsh-theme-mls-tui`.
## Install, then run dsh-tui
This assumes `dsh`, `dsh-tui` and pnpm are already installed and your existing `dsh-tui` starts succ
essfully. Supported host: dsh-TUI 0.14.x; verified version: 0.14.0.

The plugin joins the launcher's default `dsh-tui` profile, selects Acid Rain and plays the opening a
utomatically. No source checkout, host build or project-directory launch is needed. If you set `DSH_
HOME`, use the same value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration cha
ame value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration changes or updates.
First-time host users can complete its normal credential setup after the opening. The theme does not
change model, credential or session configuration.
Alternatively, download the v0.4.3 archive and replace the URL above with its local file path.

## Appearance and compatibility
- Automatic animation runs only at startup. Successful turns, cancellations and history replay never

open an animation.
- Acid Rain yellow `#D7FF00`, dark surfaces and neutral body text. The opening r

etains electric blue, maze graphics and the red panel exit.
- Actual terminal text, block glyphs, bo

rders and solid color cells replace the old full-frame sampled renderer.
- Six green scan frames use

heavy box-drawing strokes and closer spacing; the scan stage lasts 0.8 seconds longer than 0.4.2.
-
Both whale axes share one physical scale. Borders, maze and panels fill the viewport independently,

including host page margins.
- The host frame clock drives motion without the former 50ms quantizat
ion. Measured moving-frame output is approximately 58 fps; terminal and machine load affect results.
- Resizing works during playback and pause. Validation covers 48–180 columns, 20–54 rows and severa
l physical cell proportions.
The stock pixel whale has hardcoded blue pixels. The plugin hides it through public `setWhale(false)
`, keeps the themed native title and restores the previous preference on unload. Set `nativeWhale: t
rue` to retain that sprite.
Stock `tuiScenes` replaces the conversation. Panel masks animate within the plugin scene; the origin
al conversation returns on close. Progressive reveal of native content needs an additional host inte
rface. See COMPATIBILITY.md.
## Controls and configuration
`Alt+M` replays the opening. During animation, `Esc`, `Enter`, `q` or click exits; space pauses/resu
mes. Configure Option as Alt/Meta on macOS when needed.
| Cordis option | Default | Purpose |

| `autoTheme` | `true` | Select and save MLS once on activation |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | Play the s

tartup opening |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced`: brief static display; `off`: theme only |
| `graph
ics` | `cells` | `auto`: use a supported host image only for the central logo; outer geometry stays

native |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | Read host cell measurements; fall back to height / width = 2 |
| `na
tiveWhale` | `false` | Keep the unthemeable stock blue whale |
No terminal brand is required. If the host supplies no pixel metrics, arbitrary font proportions can
not be inferred exactly. Optional `cellAspect` calibration uses cell height / width, such as `1.8` o
r `2.2`. Native cell rendering needs no image protocol.
## Development
These steps are for source changes; theme installation does not require them. Source development use
s Node `^22.19 || >=24` and pnpm `11.21.0`. Keep a stock `dsh-TUI/` checkout next to this repository

For interactive development, `npm run setup:local` installs the official Harness CLI into ignored `.
runtime/`; then run `npm start`. That launcher uses isolated development configuration and sessions.
Normal use follows the `dsh-tui` workflow above. Configure API credentials through your shell envir
onment as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API k
ent as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API key.
